import io
import sys
import pathlib

import pytest

from target import get_write_function, utils


def test_write_none_writes_to_stderr(capsys):
    write = get_write_function(None)
    write("test stderr\n")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.err == "test stderr\n"


def test_write_string_path_creates_and_appends(tmp_path):
    file_path = tmp_path / "out.txt"
    write = get_write_function(str(file_path))
    write("first line\n")
    write("second line")
    assert file_path.read_text() == "first line\nsecond line"


def test_write_pathlike_object_appends(tmp_path):
    file_path = tmp_path / "out2.txt"
    write = get_write_function(file_path)  # pathlib.Path is PathLike
    write("hello")
    write(" world")
    assert file_path.read_text() == "hello world"


def test_write_custom_writable_stream(monkeypatch):
    # Make utils.WritableStream accept io.StringIO for the test
    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, "WritableStream", (io.StringIO,))
    stream = io.StringIO()
    write = get_write_function(stream)
    write("streamed data")
    assert stream.getvalue() == "streamed data"
